name: Lower Blackrock Spire Normal: Highlord Omokk's kit Fierce Blow deals one weapon swing
contract: Fierce Blow (975011) is a single melee weapon strike: its only damaging effect is Weapon Percent Damage
(effect 31) with base points 99 and one die side, so it deals 100% of the caster's weapon damage. The
coa_dungeon_boss_kit row for Highlord Omokk (9196) cast it with base points 200, doubling every hit. The
fix stores 0 so the spell's own 100% applies. Omokk pacifies himself (19951) so no auto attack, Knock Away
(prevention type 2) or other melee lands, while the triggered kit cast still goes through. Each landed
Fierce Blow then takes his weapon roll, between weapon_damage_min and at most 1.5 times that, reduced by
at most 10% by the hero's armor (600 or less against 5415 at level 59). No CoA hook changes the hit
(damage-taken controls stay at 1000). One landed cast is therefore 0.9-1.5 weapon minimums, while a
200% cast is at least 1.8. Each of the first two casts may miss or be dodged, but at least one lands;
both arrive before Omokk's 20 s Frenzy.
